style_check_scope: Authored product code and new active runner only. Archived source/patch/raw logs remain byte-identical; manifest/blob SHA checks cover all staged paths. No full-archive whitespace-green claim.
manifest_rule: staged paths exactly manifest.entries plus delivery-manifest.json; per-path bytes/SHA match working file and staged blob
excluded: runtime DB/cache/full basetemp raw/historical real raw/credentials/weights/SDK
receipt_rule: Git operation stdout/stderr/results and final SHA receipt created after sealing manifest remain local-only evidence; final receipt cannot be embedded into its own commit.
qualification: software only; no actual-workload API/physics/render/services or formal/native qualification
